# Antonio Ventilii | AI-Native Senior Software Engineer

Antonio Ventilii is a Senior Software Engineer who pairs deep hands-on engineering (TypeScript, Rust, Python, Svelte) with an AI-native workflow: orchestrating fleets of coding agents across many parallel projects, building custom agent skills, and wiring MCP (Model Context Protocol) connectors into real development pipelines. Multi-agent workflows and AI orchestration do not replace the engineering: he designs the architecture, writes the hard parts himself, and reviews every line that ships to production Web3 and finance systems.

## Key Roles
- **DFINITY Foundation** (2024-Present): Primary contributor by commit volume to the OISY Wallet, a production multi-chain browser wallet on the Internet Computer (TypeScript, Svelte, Rust canisters, chain fusion).
- **Vontobel Swiss Financial Advisers** (2020-2024): Led desk automation and FX hedge optimization while trading multi-asset markets for HNWI and UHNWI clients.

## Primary Skills
- **AI / Agentic Engineering**: Orchestration of many parallel AI projects; coding agents for implementation and review, custom Claude Code agent skills, MCP connectors, and multi-agent workflows wired into real delivery pipelines.
- **Frontend**: Svelte, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- **Systems & Backend**: Rust (Internet Computer canisters), Python (Flask, trading bots, linear programming).
- **Web3**: Internet Computer (ICP), Solana, Ethereum (EVM), multi-chain integration.

## Featured Projects
Each project on the site carries its dates and status (live, in private use, prototype), so a weeks-old experiment is never read as a product.
- **OISY Wallet** (2024-present, live): Production, multi-chain browser wallet on the Internet Computer (Apache-2.0, fully public codebase).
- **Officina** (Sep 2026-present, in private use): Collaborative software workshop on a GitHub repo: Claude agents interview, spec, build and review; people approve, verify and merge. Deterministic state machine, risk lanes recomputed from the real diff, Managed Agents, Bun + Elysia + Postgres + SvelteKit on Fly.io.
- **VICI** (Feb 2026-present, live): Social prediction-markets app at vici.market / vici.app; SvelteKit with a web3 build on the Internet Computer and a web2 build on Bun + Elysia + Postgres.
- **icdc-core** (Feb 2026-present, live): Multi-canister central-counterparty clearing engine in Rust, the backend of VICI's markets.
- **Household app** (Sep 2026-present, in private use): Two-person household app with its own MCP server and OAuth 2.1; AI agents propose, humans commit.
- **OmbrellOne** (May-Aug 2026, live): Beach-umbrella booking marketplace at ombrell.one (React, Bun + Elysia + Postgres, Stripe), originally built on the Internet Computer.
- **Privatim** (May-Jul 2026, prototype): Sovereign AI for private banking on the Internet Computer Cloud Engines, built so client data never leaves the bank's compute.
- **claude-skills** (Jun 2026): Version-controlled Claude Code agent skills, git-backed and ready to double as a plugin marketplace.
- **Verto**, **Workday AI Control Plane** (Jun 2026, prototypes): AI-personalized app variants with governance; developer AI platform with pooled budgets and provider routing.
